verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: Command Ahron and his sons, “This is the ordinance for the evening service: The fire of the sacrifice must burn all night long, until morning. The fire of the sacrifice must burn continuously.”
verses.3: And the priest shall wipe the blood from the altar and from its utensils. He shall also remove the stain that the fire has left on the altar.
verses.4: And he took off his clothes and wore other clothes instead. Then he carried the ashes outside the camp, to a place that was clean.
verses.5: And the fire on the altar shall not be extinguished. In the morning, the priest shall burn trees on it. He also shall offer sacrifices and burn the offerings of grain on it.
verses.6: Fire will always burn on the altar; it will never go out.
verses.7: And this is the law of the sacrifice that is offered by the sons of Aaron before Jehovah, in front of the altar.
verses.8: And from there, they took out all the offerings from the altar and from its utensils. They also took out all the decorations that were on the altar. Then the priest burned incense as an offering to God.
verses.9: And the offerings that were brought from there, Aaron and his sons will eat them in a holy place, in the court of the Tabernacle. They will eat them there.
verses.10: Do not be envious of their happiness. I have given it to them from my holy blood. It’s a sin and a shameful thing.
verses.11: All those who are born to Aaron shall eat it as a covenant food for your generations. It is a gift from the Lord; everything that touches it becomes holy.
verses.12: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.13: This is the offering that Aaron and his sons presented to God on the day they sacrificed him. It was a portion of food, divided into two parts: one part was given in the morning, and the other part in the evening.
verses.14: On the altar of incense, a burnt offering will be offered. It will bring offerings of grain as sacrifices. The aroma of these offerings will be presented to the LORD.
verses.15: And the priest, the High Priest, under his leadership, will make it a statute forever for the LORD. It shall be a perpetual ordinance.
verses.16: And every offering brought by the priest will not be accepted.
verses.17: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.18: I speak to Aaron and his sons, saying, “This is the law regarding sin. When one commits a sin, he must be punished before Jehovah, the Holy One. It’s a sacred thing.”
verses.19: The priest who defiles her will eat her in a holy place. But she shall be eaten in the courtyard of the Tabernacle.
verses.20: Everything that touches her skin shall be sanctified. And whatever dirt comes into contact with her clothes shall also be considered holy. It should be placed in a sacred place.
verses.21: And all those branches that will be broken off will also be destroyed. And if there’s any thorns or weeds in them, they will also be destroyed and washed away in the water.
verses.22: Every priest must eat it as a sacred food. It is truly a sacred food.
verses.23: And every sin that comes from the heart, and is brought before the altar during the holy day, shall not be eaten with fire.
